name: Damekko Succubus ~Henshoku na Kanojo ga Oishiku Ajiwau Ore no Are~
original_name: だめっこサキュバス ～偏食なカノジョがおいしく味わうオレのアレ～
source:
Kamata, a middle aged janitor for a school. He works hard but isn't well respected by the students. One day while cleaning the halls after school he comes across Yumeno Mako, one of the students. She's a gloomy girl without many friends. She says she's hungry and can't wait any longer. He tells her she should eat something and so she does. Kamata's penis!

Mako claims to be a succubus who needs human semen to live and Kamata has become her target. The lovey dovey, sweet and forbidden relationship of a middle aged janitor and student who happens to be a succubus.
translation:
蒲田，学校的中年看门人。他学习很努力，但并没有受到学生的尊重。有一天，放学后打扫大厅时，他遇到了其中一名学生梦野真子。她是一个性格阴郁的女孩，没有很多朋友。她说她饿了，不能再等了。他告诉她应该吃点东西，她就这么做了。蒲田的阴茎！

真子自称是一个需要人类精液才能生存的魅魔，蒲田成了她的目标。中年看门人和学生（碰巧是一名魅魔）之间的甜蜜、甜蜜和禁忌关系。
